name: Transport and tourism lists of government agencies — Sylhet Division
organization: Various government agencies (each row's agency in extra_json.organisation, its list in extra_json.list)
attribution: BIWTA, Ministry of Shipping, DSCC, Mymensingh City Corporation, Bangladesh Parjatan Corporation, Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism, Bangladesh Tourism Board, Bangladesh Forest Department
notes: National lists collected once and split by division (district normalised to data/seed/geo/admin_areas.csv). Names as published; descriptions are never copied. Coordinates only where the agency publishes them (Tourism Board map links) and they fall inside the row's district. Office phones/e-mails only. No licence is stated by any of the sites. Checked and not used: BIWTA ghat-wise launch passenger fare lists (অভ্যন্তরীণ নৌপথের ঘাট ভিত্তিক যাত্রীভাড়ার তালিকা, 154 + 26 pages) (scanned images without a text layer; no OCR is used, so the launch routes and ghats in them are not collected); BIWTA launch-fare notice (যাত্রীবাহী নৌযানের সর্বশেষ যাত্রীভাড়া প্রজ্ঞাপন) (per-km fare rates only (no routes or ghats)); BIWTA land register (ভূ-সম্পত্তির বিবরণ, 93 pages) (land parcels by mouza/dag (terminals, ghats, offices mixed with plots), multi-line Bijoy layout; not a facility list); BIWTA hotline numbers (জরুরি হট লাইন নাম্বার) (published as images only); BIWTA statistics / proactive-disclosure PDFs (scanned (CamScanner / Canon) PDFs without a text layer); BIWTA pontoon management system (an application (JavaScript app for staff), no public list); Bangladesh Railway station list (no station register is published: the Information Book 2023-24 has district-wise station counts only (already in bd_railway_*), the station reservation-charge file is a scan, fare/timetable files list stops without district, class or code; eticket.railway.gov.bd is disallowed by robots.txt and not used); BRTA bus fares (আন্তঃজেলা ও দূরপাল্লার রুট, ঢাকা/চট্টগ্রাম মেট্রো) (fare charts for routes, no terminal list); BRTC (only the depot list, already collected as brtc_depots_*); Roads and Highways Department (road/bridge database; no published bus-terminal or ferry-ghat list found); Dhaka Transport Coordination Authority (no terminal list; the MRT Line-6 page is a 2015 project note with proposed stations; the bus-route list is a draft); City corporations' portals (DNCC, CCC, Rajshahi, Khulna, Sylhet, Barishal, Rangpur, Cumilla, Narayanganj, Gazipur) (no bus/truck-terminal page found in their menus (khulnacity.gov.bd did not resolve); DSCC and Mymensingh used); MoCAT district-wise tourist spots (links to the district portals' tourist-spot pages, already collected as portal_tourist_spots_*); hotels.gov.bd (Parjatan booking site) (same units as the Parjatan menu; booking links kept in extra_json); Tourism GIS map (JavaScript application without a documented public data service); CAAB airports (already collected (caab_airports_*)); Parjatan unit 'পর্যটন রেস্তোরাঁ' (মাধবকুণ্ডু) (listed in the menu without a page); Parjatan district page 'গোপালগঞ্জ জেলা' (HTTP 404); Forest Department protected area 'কাপ্তাই জাতীয় উদ্যান' (location 'পার্বত্যচট্টগ্রাম' is not a district); Forest Department protected area 'পাবলাখালী বন্যপ্রাণী অভয়ারণ্য' (location 'পার্বত্য চট্টগ্রাম জেলা' is not a district); Forest Department protected area 'সোয়াচ অব নো গ্রাউন্ড মেরিন প্রোটেক্টেড এরিয়া' (location 'বঙ্গোপসাগর' is not a district); Forest Department protected area 'সেন্টমার্টিন মেরিন প্রোটেক্টেড এরিয়া' (location 'বঙ্গোপসাগর' is not a district); Forest Department protected area 'বিশেষ জীববৈচিত্র্য এলাকা' (location 'পূর্বাচল' is not a district).
